```{r}

lib_metadata <- fread("./00-documentation/library_sample_eager_metadata.tsv")

# read in the list of environmental species clusters
ancient_envt_clusters <- fread("./00-documentation/ancient_envt_clusters_26_07_2024.tsv") %>%
   bind_rows(., fread("./05-results/extra_envt_sp.tsv", sep = "\t") %>%
             separate_wider_delim(Species, delim = " ", names = c("Genus","primary_cluster")) %>%
             mutate(primary_cluster = str_remove_all(primary_cluster,"pr_cl_"),
                    primary_cluster = as.numeric(primary_cluster)))

# read in the table used for taxdump to make the kraken2 database, that has the primary cluster and the species name
taxdump_file <- fread("00-documentation/cluster_taxonomy_for_taxdump_26_07_2024.tsv") %>%
  select(id, species) %>%
  mutate(id = str_remove_all(id, "pr_cl_"),
        id = as.numeric(id))


# now get the species names of the ancient environmental species clusters
anc_envt_species <- ancient_envt_clusters %>%
  left_join(., taxdump_file %>%
              rename(primary_cluster = id,
                     Species = species), by = "primary_cluster") %>%
  select(Species)

```


```{r}

# Now we need to be able to distinguish the deep and shallow sequenced sample names
cmc_short_to_library <- lib_metadata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Eager_label, "CMC")) %>%
  mutate(Eager_label = ifelse(!str_detect(Sample_alias, "deep"), str_trunc(Eager_label, width = 8, side = "right", ellipsis = ""), Eager_label)) %>%
  select(Eager_label, Sample_alias) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Eager_label = str_remove_all(Eager_label, ".deep")) %>%
  filter(Sample_alias != "CMC001.A0201") %>%
  filter(!str_detect(Sample_alias, ".deep"))

cmc_shallow_only <- lib_metadata %>%
  filter(str_detect(Eager_label, "CMC")) %>%
  mutate(Eager_label = ifelse(!str_detect(Sample_alias, "deep"), str_trunc(Eager_label, width = 8, side = "right", ellipsis = ""), Eager_label)) %>%
  select(Eager_label) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Eager_label = str_remove_all(Eager_label, ".deep")) %>%
  group_by(Eager_label) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n == 1) %>%
  inner_join(., cmc_short_to_library) %>%
  pull(Sample_alias)

```


```{r}

# HOMD only, all oral samples
homd_sp <- fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
  anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
  # remove all CMC samples
  select(-matches("CMC")) %>%
  # add back only the deep sequenced CMC samples
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/cmc_deep_kraken2_ci_15_homd_07_2024_species.tsv")) %>%
  rename_if(str_detect(names(.), "CMC"), ~ str_remove_all(., ".deep.homd")) %>%
  # Now add back the shallow sequenced samples that weren't deep sequenced
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
            anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
            select(matches(c(cmc_shallow_only %>% str_c(collapse = "|")))) %>%
            # rename_if(str_detect(names(.), "CMC"), ~ str_trunc(., width = 8, side = "right", ellipsis = "")) %>%  
            bind_cols(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
                      anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
                      select(Species)) %>%
            select(Species, everything()), by = "Species") %>%
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_vc23_saliva.homd_species.tsv")) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

# HOMD and MAGs, all oral samples
homd_mags_sp <- fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_mags_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
  anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
  # remove all CMC samples
  select(-matches("CMC")) %>%
  # add back only the deep sequenced CMC samples
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/cmc_deep_kraken2_ci_15_homd_mags_07_2024_species.tsv")) %>%
  rename_if(str_detect(names(.), "CMC"), ~ str_remove_all(., ".deep.homd_mags")) %>%
  # Now add back the shallow sequenced samples that weren't deep sequenced
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_mags_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
            anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
            select(matches(c(cmc_shallow_only %>% str_c(collapse = "|")))) %>%
            # rename_if(str_detect(names(.), "CMC"), ~ str_trunc(., width = 8, side = "right", ellipsis = "")) %>%  
            bind_cols(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_all_oral_samples.homd_mags_11_2025_species.tsv") %>%
                      anti_join(., anc_envt_species, by = "Species") %>%
                      select(Species)) %>%
            select(Species, everything()), by = "Species") %>%
  full_join(., fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_vc23_saliva.homd_mags_species.tsv")) %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0)

```

```{r}
# Make a table with the number of samples per oral site
sample_counts <- homd_sp %>%
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
               mutate(Eager_label = str_remove_all(Eager_label, ".deep")), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Full = ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Ancient","CA",
                       ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Industrial","CI",
                              ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Industrial","PI",
                                     ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Non-industrial","PnI",
                                            ifelse(Full == "Saliva - Industrial","SI",
                                                   ifelse(Full == "Saliva - Non-industrial","SnI",
                                                          ifelse(Full == "Buccal mucosa - Industrial","BMI","BMnI")))))))) %>%
  group_by(Full) %>%
  count(name = "Samples") %>%
  ungroup

```

```{r filter_prevalence}

## HOMD and MAGs
# Filter by prevalence per oral site (>= 10% of samples)
homd_mags_prev <- homd_mags_sp %>%
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
               mutate(Eager_label = str_remove_all(Eager_label, ".deep")), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  mutate(Full = ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Ancient","CA",
                       ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Industrial","CI",
                              ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Industrial","PI",
                                     ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Non-industrial","PnI",
                                            ifelse(Full == "Saliva - Industrial","SI",
                                                   ifelse(Full == "Saliva - Non-industrial","SnI",
                                                          ifelse(Full == "Buccal mucosa - Industrial","BMI","BMnI")))))))) %>%
  # Convert to a binary count table (presence/absence)
  mutate(Counts = ifelse(Counts > 500,1,0)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  # Get the the number of samples that have each species for each oral site
  # and the percent per oral site for each species
  group_by(Full, Species) %>%
  summarize(Total_counts  = sum(Counts)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  full_join(., sample_counts, by = "Full") %>%
  group_by(Full) %>%
  mutate(Percent = Total_counts / Samples * 100) %>%
  filter(Percent > 10) %>%
  ungroup()

  # Convert to a binary count table (presence/absence)
```

```{r}

# filter the table 
# Start by getting only species that have a min of 500 reads in @least 10% of one oral site

keep_species <- homd_sp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Sample_type) %>%
              unique(), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  mutate(Sample_type = ifelse(str_detect(Sample_type, "plaque"),"plaque",Sample_type)) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Present = ifelse(Counts > 500, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Sample_type, Species) %>%
  summarize(Prevelence = sum(Present) / length(Sample_type)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Prevelence >= 0.1) %>%
  select(Species) %>%
  unique()

keep_species_hm <- homd_mags_sp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Sample_type) %>%
              unique(), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  mutate(Sample_type = ifelse(str_detect(Sample_type, "plaque"),"plaque",Sample_type)) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Present = ifelse(Counts > 500, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Sample_type, Species) %>%
  summarize(Prevelence = sum(Present) / length(Sample_type)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Prevelence >= 0.1) %>%
  select(Species) %>%
  unique()
  

```


```{r}

# Observed species table
homd_sp.os <- homd_sp %>%
  inner_join(., keep_species, by = "Species") %>%
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Library_ID",values_to = "Counts") %>%
  mutate(Counts = ifelse(Counts > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
  mutate(Database = "HOMD") %>%
  # calculate observed species for each sample with janitor 'adorn_totals'
  adorn_totals(., where = "col", name = "Observed_species") %>%
  select(Library_ID, Database, Observed_species) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  bind_rows(., homd_mags_sp %>%
            inner_join(., keep_species_hm, by = "Species") %>%
            pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Library_ID",values_to = "Counts") %>%
            mutate(Counts = ifelse(Counts > 0, 1, 0)) %>%
            pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
            mutate(Database = "HOMD_MAGs") %>%
            # calculate observed species for each sample with janitor 'adorn_totals'
            adorn_totals(., where = "col", name = "Observed_species") %>%
            select(Library_ID, Database, Observed_species) %>%
            as_tibble())
```

```{r}
# Shannon diversity with the package vegan

homd_sp.matrix <- as.matrix(homd_sp %>%
  inner_join(., keep_species, by = "Species") %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Library_ID",values_to = "Counts") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Library_ID"))
 
homd_sp.shannon <- as.data.frame(diversity(homd_sp.matrix, index = "shannon"))
names(homd_sp.shannon)[1] <- "Shannon_index"
```

```{r}
               rename(Library_ID = Eager_label) %>%

  mutate(Full = ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Ancient","CA",
                       ifelse(Full == "Calculus - Industrial","CI",
                              ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Industrial","PI",
                                     ifelse(Full == "Plaque - Non-industrial","PnI",

                                                          ifelse(Full == "Buccal mucosa - Industrial","BMI","BMnI"))))))))  %>%
  unique()
```

```{r read_counts}

# plot read counts by oral site
rc_sp <- homd_mags_filt_sp_counts %>%
  left_join(., homd_sp_alpha_meta %>%
              filter(Database == "HOMD_MAGs") %>%
              select(Library_ID, No_reads_no_human, Full) %>%
              rename(Eager_label = Library_ID,
                     Full_short = Full), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  mutate(Kept = Full_short,
         Kept = ifelse(No_reads_no_human <= 1000000, "Discarded", Full_short),
         No_reads_no_human = No_reads_no_human / 1000000) %>%
  filter(Database == "HOMD_MAGs") %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Kept = fct_relevel(Kept, "Discarded","CA","CI","PnI","PI","BMnI","BMI","SnI","SI"),
         Full_short = fct_relevel(Full_short, "CA","CI","PnI","PI","BMnI","BMI","SnI","SI")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(No_reads_no_human, Observed_species)) + # , shape = Study
    geom_point(aes(fill = Kept), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black", stroke = 0.2, alpha = 1.0) +
    geom_smooth(aes(color = Kept), method = glm, se = F, col = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = oss_colors) + #  
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    # scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks=scales::pretty_breaks(n=5), limits = c(0,1300)) +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
    # geom_vline(xintercept = 1, color = "gray30", linetype = "dashed") +
    ggpubr::stat_regline_equation(label.y = 85, label.x = 50, aes(label = ..rr.label..)) +
    xlab("No. reads (x10^6)") +
    ylab("No. species") +
    facet_wrap(~Full_short, nrow = 2)
```

```{r}
# PCA plot undamaged modern vs damaged modern
jae_sim_homd_mags <- fread("./05-results/kraken2_ci15_jae_simulations.homd_mags_11_2026_species.tsv")

# filter the table 
# Start by getting only species that have a min of 500 reads in @least 10% of one oral site
keep_species <- jae_sim_homd_mags  %>%
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  mutate(Sim_group = ifelse(str_detect(Eager_label, "old"),"Old",
                            ifelse(str_detect(Eager_label, "young"),"Young","Original"))) %>%
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Present = ifelse(Counts > 500, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Sim_group, Species) %>%
  summarize(Prevelence = sum(Present) / length(Sim_group)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Prevelence >= 0.1) %>%
  select(Species) %>%
  unique()
  

# prep the table for input to PCA
jae_sim_jae_sim_homd_mags_sp_df <- jae_sim_jae_sim_homd_mags %>% 
  inner_join(.,  keep_species, by = "Species") %>%
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to  = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  mutate(Counts = Counts + 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Eager_label")

jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca <- mixOmics::pca(jae_sim_homd_mags_sp_df, ncomp = 3, logratio = 'CLR')
plot(jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca)

# Select out the PC variates into a new table and add the metadata for plotting
jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca.variates <- as.data.frame(jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca$variates$X)
jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca.variates <- jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca.variates %>%
  rownames_to_column("Eager_label")

jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca.varmet <- jae_sim_homd_mags_sp.pca.variates %>%
  mutate(Sim_group = ifelse(str_detect(Eager_label, "old"),"Old",
                            ifelse(str_detect(Eager_label, "young"),"Young","Original")),
         EL2 = str_replace_all(Eager_label, "-","_")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  separate_wider_delim(EL2, delim = "_", names = c("SampleID","rest"), too_few = "align_start", too_many = "merge") %>%
  select(-rest) %>%
  mutate(Sim_group = fct_relevel(Sim_group, "Original", "Young","Old")) %>%
  arrange(Eager_label)

```

```{r jae_sim_fragmentation}

jae_sim_frag <- fread("./05-results/jae_sim_fragment_length_dists.tsv")

sim_frag_sum <- jae_sim_frag %>%
  rename(Sample = 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(!Sample, names_to = "Length", values_to = "Read_count") %>%
  # the "unknown" column is all the unmerged reads. We'll replace the 1st read length with 0 entries for all samples with this unknown column so we can use all reads and normalize per sample
  filter(Length != "142") %>%
  mutate(Length = str_replace_all(Length, "unknown","142")) %>%
  mutate(Length = as.numeric(Length)) %>%
  # everything longer than 142 is all 0 entries
  filter(Length <= 142) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(norm_count = Read_count / sum(Read_count)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Sim_group = ifelse(Sample == "old","old",
                            ifelse(Sample == "young","young","original")),
         Sim_group = fct_relevel(Sim_group, "original","young","old")) %>%
  filter(Length >= 30) 

```

```{r}

# read in the taxonomy file used for taxdump for building the Kraken2 database
taxdump_tax <- fread("./00-documentation/cluster_taxonomy_for_taxdump_26_07_2024.tsv")

# order the classes by domain
cl_order <- taxdump_tax %>%
  select(domain, phylum, class) %>%
  unique() %>%
  arrange(domain, phylum, class)  %>%
  pull(class)

# classes with no reads in either HOMD or HOMD_MAGs tables
none_detected <- fread("./05-results/class_order_table.tsv") %>%
  pull(Class)

```


```{r}

class_counts <- homd_sp %>%
  inner_join(., taxdump_tax %>%
               select(class, species) %>%
               unique() %>%
               rename(Species = species), by = "Species") %>%
  select(class, Species, everything()) %>%
  pivot_longer(!class:Species, names_to = "Library_ID", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  group_by(Library_ID, class) %>%
  summarize(HOMD_total_counts = sum(Counts)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Library_ID) %>%
  mutate(HOMD_pct = HOMD_total_counts / sum(HOMD_total_counts) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  full_join(., homd_mags_sp %>%
             inner_join(., taxdump_tax %>%
                          select(class, species) %>%
                          unique() %>%
                          rename(Species = species), by = "Species") %>%
             select(class, Species, everything()) %>%
             pivot_longer(!class:Species, names_to = "Library_ID", values_to = "Counts") %>%
             group_by(Library_ID, class) %>%
             summarize(HOMD_MAGs_total_counts = sum(Counts)) %>%
             ungroup() %>%
             group_by(Library_ID) %>%
             mutate(HOMD_MAGs_pct = HOMD_MAGs_total_counts / sum(HOMD_MAGs_total_counts) * 100) %>%
             ungroup(), by = c("Library_ID","class")) %>%
  inner_join(., lib_metadata  %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
              rename(Library_ID = Eager_label) %>%
              unique(), by = "Library_ID") %>%
  select(Full, everything())
  

```


```{r}

ac_class <- class_counts %>%
  filter(class %in% none_detected) %>%
  mutate(Percent_inc = (HOMD_MAGs_pct - HOMD_pct) / HOMD_pct * 100,
         Fold_change = log2(HOMD_MAGs_pct / HOMD_pct),
         Difference = HOMD_MAGs_pct - HOMD_pct,
         class = fct_relevel(class, cl_order)) %>%
  # now deal with Inf entries
  mutate(Fold_change = ifelse(HOMD_MAGs_pct == 0,-10,Fold_change),
         Fold_change = ifelse(HOMD_pct == 0,20,Fold_change)) %>%
  # convert lines where total counts for both HOMD and HOMD_MAGs is 0 to 0 instead of NA
  mutate(Fold_change = ifelse(is.na(Fold_change),0,Fold_change)) %>%
  # remove these added values so they aren't contributing to the average calculation below
  filter(Fold_change != -10, Fold_change != 20) %>%
  filter(str_detect(Full, "Calculus")) %>%
  arrange(class) %>%
  group_by(Full, class) %>%
  summarize(avg_fold_change = mean(Fold_change),
            sd_fold_change = sd(Fold_change)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(Full = fct_relevel(Full, "Calculus - Industrial", "Calculus - Ancient")) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = avg_fold_change, y = class, group = Full)) +
     geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "gray40") +
   geom_point(aes(fill = Full, shape = Full, size = Full), stroke = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = avg_fold_change-sd_fold_change, xmax = avg_fold_change+sd_fold_change, color = Full), height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,25)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = os_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = os_colors) +
    scale_size_manual(values = c(2, 1.5)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust =  0.5, size = 10),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size=10)) +
    theme(legend.position = "top") +
    scale_y_discrete(limits=rev) +
    ylab("Class") +
    xlab("log2(fold change in mean abundance) (%) HOMD vs. HOMD_MAGs")
```

```{r}
  mutate(reads_log = log10(No_reads_no_human)) %>%
  left_join(., kraken2_stats %>%
              filter(Database == "HOMD_MAGs") %>%
              select(Eager_label, Percent_cl), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  drop_na(number_species) %>%
  drop_na(Age_BP) %>%
  drop_na(avg_rl) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(Age_BP, number_species)) + # , shape = Study
    geom_point(aes(fill = Percent_cl, size = avg_rl), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 100)) + #  , name = "Contamination", breaks=c(1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000,7000)
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    scale_x_log10(labels = label_comma()) +
    # labs(color = "Source", shape = "Source") +
    # theme(legend.position="none") +
    xlab("Age (BP)") +
    ylab("No. species") +
    ggtitle("HOMD_MAGs")
homd_mags_color_size

step3 <- homd_color_size | homd_mags_color_size
```

```{r anc_calc_homd_PCA}
# prep the table for input to PCA
homd_ac_sp_df <- homd_sp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to  = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
              unique(), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  filter(Full == "Calculus - Ancient") %>%
  select(-Full) %>%
  mutate(Counts = Counts + 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Eager_label")

homd_ac_sp.pca <- mixOmics::pca(homd_ac_sp_df, ncomp = 3, logratio = 'CLR')
plot(homd_ac_sp.pca)

# Select out the PC variates into a new table and add the metadata for plotting
homd_ac_sp.pca.variates <- as.data.frame(homd_ac_sp.pca$variates$X)
homd_ac_sp.pca.variates <- homd_ac_sp.pca.variates %>%
  rownames_to_column("Eager_label")

homd_ac_sp.pca.varmet <- homd_ac_sp.pca.variates %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>% select(-Run_accession,-Sample_alias,-Study_accession), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Eager_label)

anc_calc_homd_pca <- homd_ac_sp.pca.varmet %>%
  # add classfication metrics
  left_join(., kraken2_stats %>%
              filter(Database == "HOMD") %>%
              select(Eager_label, Percent_cl), by = "Eager_label")%>%
  mutate(log_age_bp = log10(Age_BP)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(PC1, PC2, fill = Percent_cl, shape = Host)) + # Host, Continent, Age_BP, avg_gc, avg_rl, No_reads_no_human, log_Age_BP, log_total_reads, Observed_species, Shannon_index, Percent_cl
    geom_point(aes(fill = Percent_cl, size = avg_rl), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2) +
    # geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") + # 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,21)) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = continent_colors) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 100)) + # 
    xlab(paste("PC1 - ", 100*(round(data.frame(homd_ac_sp.pca$prop_expl_var$X[1]), digits = 3)), "%", sep = "")) +
    ylab(paste("PC2 - ", 100*(round(data.frame(homd_ac_sp.pca$prop_expl_var$X[2]), digits = 3)), "%", sep = "")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    # labs(fill = "Continent", shape = "Source") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 10))

anc_calc_homd_pca

```

```{r anc_calc_homd_mags_PCA}

keep_sp_calc <- homd_mags_sp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
              unique(), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  filter(Full == "Calculus - Ancient") %>% 
  unique() %>%
  mutate(Present = ifelse(Counts > 500, 1, 0)) %>%
  group_by(Full, Species) %>%
  summarize(Prevelence = sum(Present) / length(Full)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Prevelence >= 0.1) %>%
  select(Species) %>%
  unique()

# prep the table for input to PCA
homd_mags_ac_sp_df <- homd_mags_sp %>% 
  pivot_longer(!Species, names_to  = "Eager_label", values_to = "Counts") %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>%
              select(Eager_label, Full) %>%
              unique(), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  filter(Full == "Calculus - Ancient") %>%
  select(-Full) %>%
  inner_join(., keep_sp_calc, by = "Species") %>%
  mutate(Counts = Counts + 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "Species", values_from = "Counts") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Eager_label")

homd_mags_ac_sp.pca <- mixOmics::pca(homd_mags_ac_sp_df, ncomp = 3, logratio = 'CLR')
plot(homd_mags_ac_sp.pca)

# Select out the PC variates into a new table and add the metadata for plotting
homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.variates <- as.data.frame(homd_mags_ac_sp.pca$variates$X)
homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.variates <- homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.variates %>%
  rownames_to_column("Eager_label")

homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.varmet <- homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.variates %>%
  left_join(., lib_metadata %>% select(-Run_accession,-Sample_alias,-Study_accession), by = "Eager_label") %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(Eager_label)

anc_calc_homd_mags_pca <- homd_mags_ac_sp.pca.varmet %>%
  # add classfication metrics
  left_join(., kraken2_stats %>%
              filter(Database == "HOMD_MAGs") %>%
              select(Eager_label, Percent_cl), by = "Eager_label")%>%
  mutate(log_age_bp = log10(Age_BP)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(PC1, PC2, fill = Percent_cl, shape = Host)) + # Host, Continent, Age_BP, avg_gc, avg_rl, No_reads_no_human, log_Age_BP, log_total_reads, Observed_species, Shannon_index, Percent_cl, log_age_bp
    geom_point(aes(fill = Percent_cl, size = avg_rl), shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.2) +
    # geom_point(size = 3, stroke = 0.2, color = "black") + # 
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(21,21)) +
    # scale_fill_manual(values = continent_colors) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 100)) + # 
    xlab(paste("PC1 - ", 100*(round(data.frame(homd_mags_ac_sp.pca$prop_expl_var$X[1]), digits = 3)), "%", sep = "")) +
    ylab(paste("PC2 - ", 100*(round(data.frame(homd_mags_ac_sp.pca$prop_expl_var$X[2]), digits = 3)), "%", sep = "")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    # labs(fill = "Continent", shape = "Source") +
    theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 10))
```
